The third dimension is never stated; wid is back-calculated from 3L over the 11 x 5.5in face (about 3in / 7.6cm) and is therefore mine. liters holds the 5L expanded maximum; rolled down it is 3L.

features.mount: sits in the centre of a Jones H-Bar or Surly Moloko (also traditional bars) on five Total Hook straps, with a hook-and-cord attachment at the head tube; two 1in loops underneath for extra gear

products.name: Barley Saddlebag
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 9L. Material: 18 oz Waxed Cotton Duck. Dimensions (WxHxD): 18x15x29cms
products.dims_note: AXIS ORDER REASSIGNED. The page labels 18x15x29 as WxHxD, which would make the Barley 18cm across the bike and 29cm front-to-back — the wrong shape for a Carradice saddlebag, and inconsistent with the Zipped Roll (28x15x10) and Camper Longflap (36x26x22) on the same site, where the first figure is clearly the across-bike width. I have kept their 15cm height and put the 29cm on the across-bike axis. Volume checks out either way at about 7.8L against a stated 9L.

features.mount: leather straps to saddle loops or a Bagman support rack

products.name: Camper Longflap Saddlebag
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 24L. Material: 18 oz Waxed Cotton Duck. Dimensions (WxHxD): 36 x 26 x 22 cm
products.dims_note: Printed WxHxD maps naturally here: 36cm across the bike, 26cm tall, 22cm front-to-back. That box is 20.6L against a stated 24L because the longflap extends upward over an overstuffed load, so the dims are the body and the litres include the flap. Largest bag in the Originals range.

products.dims_note: Cleanest figures on the Carradice site: 28cm across the bike, 15cm tall, 10cm deep gives 4.2L against a stated 3.5L, the usual bounding-box overshoot. Field Green with burgundy leather and brown webbing is the only colourway for this version.

products.name: Cambrian Lightweight Saddlebag
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 16L. Dimensions (WxHxD): 28 x 30 x 16cm. Waterproof 1000 military grade denier Cordura, taped sealed orange lining.
products.dims_note: Roll-top, and only one height is published, so the 30cm must be the unrolled maximum — there is no rolled minimum on the page to interpolate from, hence dims_state unrolled with the figure left at the maximum. The 28 x 30 x 16 box is 13.4L against a stated 16L.

features.mount: saddle and seatpost, or the patented Bagman Sport Quick Release support rack; rigid internal base support, D-rings on top

products.name: Bowland Bar Bag
products.dims_raw: Dimensions (WxHxD): 12L: 30x18x26cm / 20L: 35x30x20cm
products.dims_note: AXIS ORDER REASSIGNED for the 12L. Taken literally its WxHxD would be 30 wide, 18 tall, 26 deep — deeper than it is tall — while the 20L on the same line reads 35 wide, 30 tall, 20 deep. The 12L's last two figures are transposed, so I have used 30 x 26 x 18. Roll-top, so the height is a maximum. A 20L version exists at 35 x 30 x 20cm.

name: Fairweather

products.name: Handlebar Bag ADV
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 19L. Dimensions: length 22cm/8.5" (when the roll top is stretched: 38cm/15"), width 42cm/16.5" (including side pockets), depth 22cm/8.5". Material: Cordura Nylon Fabric
products.dims_note: Their 'length' is the vertical roll dimension: 22cm rolled down, 38cm stretched, so packed hgt = 22 + 0.3*(38-22) = 26.8cm. len uses the stated 42cm across the bars, which INCLUDES the side pockets, so the main body alone is narrower. liters is the 19L maximum, which corresponds to the fully stretched roll. Needs 18-25cm bar-to-rack clearance with a rack, over 25cm without.

features.mount: handlebar with or without a front rack / bag supporter; detachable top flap; removable waterproof rip-nylon liner

products.name: Seat Bag
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 3-6 liters. Dimensions: L 28cm-48cm x W 14cm x H 16cm. Weight: 320g (AVG.)
products.dims_note: Length 28-48cm is rolled-to-unrolled; packed len = 28 + 0.3*(48-28) = 34cm. Width and height are fixed. liters holds the 6L top of the stated 3-6L range, matching the unrolled length rather than the packed one.

features.mount: saddle rails and seatpost

products.name: Road Bar Bag
products.dims_raw: Capacity: 1.7L. Size: diameter 14cm, bag circumference 43cm, width 21cm (when side rolls are closed) - 66cm (when both side rolls are expanded). Weight: 170g (AVG.)
products.dims_note: Width across the bars is 21cm with both side rolls closed and 66cm with both expanded; packed len = 21 + 0.3*(66-21) = 34.5cm. hgt and wid both come from the stated 14cm diameter. The 1.7L capacity is quoted for the main compartment, not the fully expanded state, so litres and packed length are not on the same footing here.

products.name: Stem Bag+

products.dims_note: Their 'L 16cm' is the vertical height of the pouch, so it maps to hgt; the 11 x 11 square section gives len and wid. Fits a 32oz Nalgene. Smaller Stem Bag and Stem Bag Light versions also exist.

products.name: Frame Bag ADV (Medium)
products.dims_raw: Size small - Capacity: 3.6 liters, Dimension: L 33cm x H 27.5cm x W 6cm. Size medium - Capacity: 4L, Dimension: L 34cm x H 33cm x W 6cm. Weight: 141g (AVG.)
products.dims_note: Fixed-size zip bag, printed L x H x W maps straight across. This entry is the Medium; a Small exists at 33 x 27.5 x 6cm / 3.6L. Fills roughly 3/4 of the triangle while leaving room for a bottle cage.
